recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current HL7/fhir source follow-up is needed; any recurrence should be handled in R4B generation tooling or the R4B branch.
issue_request: FHIR-34433 was a Published/Persuasive R4B technical correction reporting that R4B-shipped ConceptMap instances contained the R5-only ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship element even though R4B uses target.equivalence.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit mentions FHIR-34433. The Jira comment links HL7/kindling#69, merged 2022-04-07, which says R4B generation must use R4 ConceptMaps and resources rather than R5 resources for generated instances.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes ConceptMap in the current build, and the current ConceptMap StructureDefinition defines ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship. origin/R4B has ConceptMap sources using equivalence and no relationship elements, while the current branch uses relationship and no equivalence elements. FHIR-35783 is the same conceptmaps.xml family, and FHIR-35784 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Removing relationship from current source would be incorrect because the issue applied to R4B publication generation, not current FHIR ConceptMap semantics.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published R4B issue for conceptmaps.xml using relationship/R5 codes where equivalence/R4B codes were required; decided opportunistically.
